purpose: Fresh execution of zero-cost independent barcode semantic-verifier discovery after compound, full-catalog, morphology, and joint-coverage repairs.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python canonical/tests/test_capability_discovery.py
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/capability_discovery.py')
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('capability_discovery_probe_v2',p)
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
out=m.search_all('decode barcode image',limit_per_source=30)
path=pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-BARCODE-SEMANTIC-VERIFIER-DISCOVERY-002__RESULT.json')
path.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
hits=[x for x in out.get('candidates',[]) if 'zbar' in str(x.get('name','')).lower()]
print('BARCODE_VERIFIER_DISCOVERY_V2_COMPLETE',json.dumps({'zbar_hits':hits,'top':out.get('candidates',[])[:15]},sort_keys=True))
PY
